hint.missingHgtDirPath: A digital elevation model must be defined in the general settings so that the elevation of the map center can be displayed.
hint.items:
Dashboard items display information about the map, your position, and active routes or tracks.

Items can be reordered using drag and drop.
hint.fontSize:
Default font size for all dashboard elements.

Applies to all dashboard elements for which no font size is specified.
hint.alignment: Controls how dashboard items are positioned horizontally. Choose to align them left, center, or right, or distribute them evenly across the available space.
hint.updateRate:
How quickly the dashboard elements are updated.

A fast refresh rate can lead to a loss of performance on slow devices.

item.fontSize: Override the font size for this specific dashboard element. When not set, the default dashboard font size is used.
item.minWidth: The minimum width of the dashboard element in pixels.
item.unit:
The unit in which the dashboard element is displayed.

The default setting of the unit can be adjusted in the general settings under "Unit preferences".
item.decimalPlaces: Override the number of decimal places for this specific dashboard element. When not set, the default from the unit preferences is used.
